subject: RFP bake-off: request for evaluation credits and governance note
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@edgehealth.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP bake-off: request for evaluation credits and governance note

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency profile on 8k sequences. We're running a formal bake-off next month comparing Redwood vs. two other providers, and procurement has asked that we get a clear credit allocation and trial window up front so the technical and procurement teams can schedule tests and security review.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a named evaluation credit pool (token-based) we can use across three days of benchmarking and a short follow-up tuning window?
- Procurement also needs a short note on how tokens are billed, retention of logs during the eval, and what audit evidence (SOC2 artifact pointer) you can provide during the bake-off.

Attached is the RFP and a rough test plan. Our timeline is tight — kickoff 07/27, results due 08/03 — so we'd appreciate confirmation by 07/20.

Best,
Aisha Gupta
Director, Platform Engineering
EdgeHealth

Attachments: EdgeHealth_RFP.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off: request for evaluation credits and governance note

Thanks for the clear timeline, Aisha — excited to support EdgeHealth on this bake-off.

Quick proposal from our side:
- Provisional evaluation credit: 75,000 token-equivalent credit, valid for 30 days from activation. This should cover the three-day benchmark and follow-up tuning.
- Trial window: we can activate the pool at kickoff (07/27) and keep a 7-day buffer for follow-up tests.
- Governance/evidence: we will provide our SOC 2 Type II summary link and a short one-pager on data retention and how audit logs can be exported during the trial. We do not retain customer prompt/content beyond the configured retention window unless the customer opts in for longer-term logging.

Next step: I need internal sign-off to finalize the credit allocation and confirm any procurement constraints (credits tied to a signed MSA/SOW vs. unconditional evaluation). Vanessa/jordan/karthik — can one of you confirm if 75k is acceptable as a provisional offering and whether we need a simple SOW signature before activation? If procurement requires a signature, we can route a one-page SOW via DocuSign for a quick sign.

Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jul 19, 2026 at 09:12 Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@edgehealth.ai> wrote:
> (original message quoted)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off: request for evaluation credits and governance note

Marcus — thanks for the summary. A few governance/ops notes from my side: 

- 75k token-equivalent is within promotional limits for a baked-in review (ok to approve from Sales side).
- Finance/legal prefer credits to be contingent on a signed one-page SOW that confirms the evaluation window and a standard IP/data clause; this avoids disputes on usage and expiration. We can keep the SOW very lightweight — link below to the template.
- For SOC2/proof: share our SOC2 Summary + pointer to an internal Redacted Audit Log export process (ops will work directly with EdgeHealth SRE if they need a live export during benchmarking).

Operational ask: Jordan, can you own the activation and coordinate with Ops to limit the credit to the EdgeHealth project id and set a strict expiry (T+30 from activation)? Karthik — please prepare the SOW template for signature.

I can approve the 75k provisional as long as we document the SOW and retention window.

Vanessa
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)
Related link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/EGH-2026-provisional
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@edgehealth.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off: request for evaluation credits and governance note

Thanks Marcus and Vanessa — that approach should work for us. A couple quick clarifications before we sign: 

- Can the credit pool be scoped to a single project/team tag so our engineers only consume it for the benchmark runs?
- What is the expiry enforcement mechanism? We want the tokens to stop if the test ends early.

Procurement also asked for a short clause confirming Redwood will not use customer prompts/data for model training during this evaluation. If you can add that to the one-page SOW, procurement can sign same-day.

I'll attach our test matrix for visibility. Looking forward to kickoff on 07/27.

Best,
Aisha

Attachments: EdgeHealth_eval_plan.xlsx
